name: 72 Transformations
mechanic: Cue: copy any spotlit card's skill; transformations are counted across the run, and at 72 this card permanently upgrades to Legendary stats.

name: Air
mechanic: Whenever its stack settles, this card floats to the top of its stack.

name: Ascetic
mechanic: Immune to row- and floor-targeting hazards.

name: Audience Patience
mechanic: Each show, patience starts at N; each grab/place spends 1 patience, a unique effect trigger refunds 1; at 0 patience the Entrance drops automatically.

name: Automaton
mechanic: Every Next this card performs its cue automatically for free, but it can never be cued manually.

name: Avalanche
mechanic: After scoring, reduces the show's goal by the number of cards currently on the board.

name: Bahurupiya
mechanic: At the start of each show this card arrives as a random different class, deterministic per seed, counting for that class's group effects.

name: Balls
mechanic: Ball props arc down the column, picking talent targets at spawn, and apply the Juggling status; a Juggling card pays out its column score when it later scores.

name: Bauta
mechanic: This card's rarity and identity are hidden from inspections, towns, and effects until it scores.

name: Bian Lian
mechanic: Cue: instantly swap this card's rank and suit with an adjacent card's.

name: Blondin's Crossing
mechanic: Once per show: shift an entire row one column left or right, wrapping around the board edge.

name: Blowdown
mechanic: Weather boss: at show start and each Next, a random seeded Grand Entrance card is discarded.

name: Bottom Deal
mechanic: Cue: this turn, draws come from the bottom of the deck instead of the top.

name: Brass Check
mechanic: Whenever this card's effects trigger, mint a Gold token card onto the top of the draw deck.

name: Brass Ring
mechanic: A token rotates one column per turn; if that column scores while the ring is on it, the meld pays double and a Ticket Stub is banked.

name: Brodie's Leap
mechanic: Banks fame each show for a stunt that never happened; if ever exposed by an inspection effect, loses double everything banked.

name: Buried Alive
mechanic: Cue: remove a card from the game for 2 shows; it returns upgraded one rarity, with a seeded chance it does not return at all.

name: Canvas
mechanic: The first debuff or status applied to this card each show is discarded.

name: Cascade Scorer
mechanic: On Submit, scores all rows of the board first, then all columns simultaneously per row band.

name: Cheat Day
mechanic: If the show is won with cards still in the draw deck, every remaining card in the deck gains +1 rank permanently.

name: Chindon'ya
mechanic: Consumable: the next town's fame requirement drops 15%.

name: Clever Hans
mechanic: Counts as a copy of its highest adjacent neighbor's rank; if it has no neighbors, its rank is 1.

name: Clown Car
mechanic: On Next, draws one extra card into this card's column, plus one more per Clown-class card scored last submit.

name: Colleano's Somersault
mechanic: Cue: swaps positions with the single card covering it.

name: Column Poker
mechanic: While spotlit, every full 5-card band of this card's column is evaluated as a poker hand at scoring.

name: Common
mechanic: While in the deck, doubles the chance of Rare cards appearing in packs/shops.

name: Contract Ink
mechanic: Scores +X points per show it is played; if benched two shows in a row, it is removed from the deck.

name: Custard Pie
mechanic: Cue: target card's suit becomes Balls; if that completes a flush row, gain bonus multiplier immediately.

name: Dead Man's Hand
mechanic: Hidden rule: scoring two pair, Aces over Eights, in one row pays a jackpot and triggers a map event.

name: Dedi's Mercy
mechanic: Once per show, when one of your cards is destroyed, restore it to the discard pile instead.

name: Deus ex Machina
mechanic: Consumable, once per run: when a show is lost, it is instead won at exactly the goal.

name: Diabolo
mechanic: Every Next, alternates between two adjacent columns, granting bonus points to the top card of the column it leaves.

name: Digital
mechanic: This card cannot be discarded from the board by any effect.

name: Double Trigger
mechanic: All of this card's effects trigger twice, once per scoring pass.

name: Drumroll
mechanic: The last meld scored each act gets bonus multiplier.

name: Duende
mechanic: When an act scores 5 or more distinct combo classes and every meld that act raised the combo, this card triggers and triples the act's payout.

name: Earth
mechanic: Whenever its stack settles, this card sinks to the bottom of its stack, carrying its stamp with it.

name: Echoing Trigger
mechanic: All triggers on the board repeat once, per card per scoring pass.

name: Edith's Bayonet
mechanic: Cue: permanently destroy one Knives-suit card and add its rank to this card's own, forever.

name: Electric
mechanic: When an Electric card scores, an arc prop hops card-to-card through orthogonally adjacent cards, adding points per link, until it reaches a gap.

name: Epic
mechanic: While in the deck, doubles the chance of Legendary cards appearing in packs/shops.

name: Escaramuza
mechanic: When the board's column heights read the same left-to-right as right-to-left at scoring, gain bonus multiplier on the act.

name: Exchange Voucher
mechanic: Usable from anywhere (including the deck): cue to swap this card's position with any card on screen.

name: Extra Point
mechanic: Gain extra flat points on score (currently +10).

name: Eye of God
mechanic: Reveals all decks (including draw order), the hidden rules deck, and the true identity of every card, including Gaffs, Humbugs, and Riders.

name: Fairy Floss
mechanic: When scored, gives +1 rank to all adjacent cards for the rest of the show.

name: Final Act
mechanic: After every shuffle, this card sinks below all non-Heavy cards and only enters play after the rest of the deck is drawn; it scores a bonus multiplier as the closer.

name: Firetown's Snub
mechanic: Town hazard: Flames-suit effects score nothing here, and Burning statuses do not multiply.

name: Fireworks
mechanic: When a Fireworks card scores, its rocket prop rises up the column and banks the column score directly.

name: First Act
mechanic: After every shuffle, this card moves to the top of the deck and enters play alone before any other card that Next.

name: First of May
mechanic: A random Common card that permanently upgrades to its Rare version after scoring 10 times across the run.

name: Flagpole Sitter
mechanic: Gains bonus points for each consecutive show it ends as the top card of the same column; any move resets the streak to zero.

name: Flames
mechanic: Fire props arc down the column applying Burning; a Burning card's suit effect fires with multiplied prop count, and fire cascades can chain within the same act.

name: Flash
mechanic: The first time this card would score each show it scores triple; every later score that show is zero.

name: Flash Mob
mechanic: Cue, once per show: deploy the entire Grand Entrance onto the board in one action, columns assigned left-to-right automatically.

name: Flea Circus
mechanic: When scored, counts as five rank-1 cards for combo-counting purposes (not points).

name: Fool's License
mechanic: While spotlit, choose one rule card in the rules deck whose effect is ignored.

name: Foot of God
mechanic: Cue: this card switches locations with any card on screen (board, Entrance, or decks).

name: Frankenstein
mechanic: On submit, merges with the cards directly above and below it into one 3-card stack of summed rank that stays in the zone after scoring.

name: Free Undo
mechanic: Grants one free undo per turn that does not carry over.

name: Genie's Wish
mechanic: Consumable: choose any card in your deck and create a full copy of it in the Entrance for this show, which becomes permanent in the deck afterward.

name: Ghost Light
mechanic: This card does not block the Spotlight of cards beneath it; they stay active as if uncovered.

name: Glass
mechanic: Scores double points, and is destroyed permanently after its third score.

name: Global
mechanic: This card's modifiers are active from anywhere: board, Entrance, draw deck, or discard.

name: Gold
mechanic: Gold-suit cards count as currency at full trade value in shops; when a Gold card scores, it mints a Heavy Gold token card to the deck bottom.
status: Modified (type instead of suit, effect is that it increases its own cost, is heavy) (gold gen should be its own talent)

name: Gold Card
mechanic: Money token: full trade value at shops, always sinks to the deck bottom (Heavy), and scores 0 in melds.

name: Golden Buzzer
mechanic: Consumable, once per run: skips one town's requirement entirely for an instant win with full rewards.

name: Grand Spec
mechanic: If all columns scored a meld this act, doubles the act's combo multiplier.

name: Grand Vanish
mechanic: Cue, once per show: hide an entire column so it cannot be seen, targeted, scored, or touched for one turn; it then returns with bonus points on every card.

name: Greasepaint
mechanic: This card counts as a Clown-class card in addition to its own class.

name: Grock's Instrument
mechanic: Each act this card would score, it instead hops one column away and banks the points; when it has no legal hop left, it scores everything banked at once.

name: Half-Step
mechanic: This card has rank N and a half, letting it stack legally between rank N and N+1 in runs, but it never participates in poker melds.

name: Hall of Mirrors
mechanic: Boss: duplicates the board's reflection with fake copies of your cards interleaved into rows; they score 0.

name: Hanafuda Reskin
mechanic: When a town outlaws a suit, all your cards of that suit count as the suit of the adjacent card for that show.

name: Hand of God
mechanic: Cue: move any card to any board location ignoring legality, or reorder the cards inside any deck.

name: Harlequin
mechanic: This card counts as both of its printed suits for every comparison, meld, and suit effect, firing both suits' props.

name: Heavy
mechanic: After any shuffle or return to deck, this card sinks to the deck bottom.

name: Helium
mechanic: After any shuffle or return to deck, this card rises to the top and is always the first card drawn on Next.

name: Hey Rube!
mechanic: Boss: each submit, every card in the rightmost column gets Exhausted unless an Escape Artist-class card stands in that column.

name: Hikinuki
mechanic: On scoring, swaps this card's stamp with any stamp held in reserve.

name: HONK
mechanic: Cue: makes a honk sound, with unlimited uses and no other effect.

name: Hoops
mechanic: When a Hoops card scores, hoop props sweep the scored row and re-score every skill card they pass through; talented spawners suppress their own suit effect.

name: Hooptown's Snub
mechanic: Town hazard: Hoops-suit effects score nothing here.

name: Hopak Burst
mechanic: Cue, 1 charge per show: jumps this card's entire stack one row upward in its column, sliding everything beneath up.

name: Human Cannonball
mechanic: Cue: fire the bottom card of any column to the top of any other column.

name: Humbug
mechanic: While covered, counts as a copy of the most valuable card in its row; when uncovered, is revealed as junk (rank 2, base score only).

name: Hungry Hippo
mechanic: Consumes cards dropped onto it, adding their rank to its own up to a cap of 13, and returns everything eaten at show end.

name: Hype Poster
mechanic: Consumable: doubles the next show's fame requirement, in exchange for its rewards (pack quality, rarity odds) scaling up two tiers.

name: Input Column
mechanic: One per column: on Next, drops its upper-zone stack into the paired board column, then draws a card from the deck to refill.

name: Iron Body
mechanic: Immune to the first destruction or debuff that targets this card each show.

name: Joey Grimaldi
mechanic: Leader: once per turn, freely swaps the ranks of any two adjacent cards without spending a cue.

name: John Robinson
mechanic: Elite hazard: the show is shortened to 2 submits instead of 3, with the goal unchanged.

name: Juggletown's Snub
mechanic: Town hazard: Balls-suit effects score nothing here, though Juggling statuses still apply.

name: Jumbo
mechanic: Heavy: no cards may be placed on this card, but it can be placed on anything; scores bonus points per card beneath it when scored.

name: Karagöz & Hacivat
mechanic: Bound pair: each gains bonus multiplier while they are in opposite zones (one in the Entrance, one on the board).

name: Kayfabe
mechanic: While in play, all Gaff/Humbug/fake cards count as real and score as what they pretend to be; removing this card reverts that.

name: Klyaksa
mechanic: Comes with a free rank-1 token card that shuffles into the deck and follows this card's column when drawn.

name: Knifetown's Snub
mechanic: Town hazard: Knives-suit effects score nothing here.

name: Knives
mechanic: Knife props launch from the opposite row edge and score plain non-skill prop cards they pass; the spawner also scores itself.

name: Kuroko
mechanic: This card does not block Spotlight beneath it and cannot be targeted by boss or town effects.

name: Label
mechanic: While this rule card is in the (normally hidden) rules deck, its effect text is announced on the board.

name: Liberty Horses
mechanic: On Next, all Animal-class cards in the Grand Entrance rearrange into ascending rank order before dropping.

name: Lithograph
mechanic: While this card sits in the Grand Entrance its skill is active globally; on the board it has no effect.

name: Lloyd's Policy
mechanic: The first time this card would be destroyed or debuffed, prevent it and mint 2 Gold tokens instead.

name: Lot Lice
mechanic: Town hazard: the first submit each show scores 0 fame.

name: Lucky Streak
mechanic: Grants +1 reroll per shop visit; after it activates, repeated actions for the rest of the show never repeat identical results.

name: Mabel's Tigers
mechanic: Consumes prop (skill-less) cards dropped on it, gaining +1 rank per card eaten, with no cap, permanently.

name: Madame Zora's Eye
mechanic: The next card to be drawn is always visible above the deck slot while this card is anywhere in play.

name: Mallakhamb Pole
mechanic: While spotlit, every card in this card's column gains bonus points per row of column height when the column scores.

name: Marked
mechanic: Always shows this card's position in the draw deck.

name: Marotte
mechanic: When this card is destroyed, a rank-1 copy of it (same skill, no stamp) survives in its place.

name: Maximum Effort
mechanic: Doubles this card's points on score; afterward it is Exhausted (scores nothing) until a show passes in which it was never played.

name: Meal Call
mechanic: Cue, once per show: every card on the board removes one debuff or status.

name: Metamorphosis
mechanic: Cue: swap this card with any card in the draw deck (seen or unseen), taking its board position.

name: Milk Can
mechanic: Cue: place one board card inside the can, safe and out of play; cue again on a later turn to retrieve it to the Entrance.

name: Misdirection
mechanic: While spotlit, the topmost covered card in each adjacent column is also treated as spotlit.

name: Mr. Punch
mechanic: Each act, gains points for every adjacent card debuffed or destroyed.

name: Mud Show
mechanic: Town hazard: every stack pickup this show costs 1 discard from the deck top.

name: Mystery Box
mechanic: On game start, this card becomes a random skill for the rest of the run, deterministic per seed.

name: Null
mechanic: Junk material inserted by hazards: occupies a slot, scores nothing, and melds nothing.

name: OG Grabber
mechanic: Default grab legality: a stack may be picked up if it is an ascending or descending run with no two same-suit cards adjacent.

name: OG Placer
mechanic: Default placement legality: a stack may be placed where the join continues a legal run without same-suit contact.

name: Outlawed
mechanic: In pious/lawful towns this card cannot score at all; everywhere else it scores double.

name: Pagliacci
mechanic: Gains bonus multiplier while this card carries any debuff or negative status.

name: Pandora's Box
mechanic: On game start becomes a random skill; on game end resets back to this skill.

name: Paper
mechanic: Default material with no modifier behavior.

name: Paper the House
mechanic: Consumable: auto-passes one town's fame check, but grants zero fame and zero rewards from it.

name: Peanut Pitch
mechanic: Cue, 3 charges per show: gives bonus points to any one card on the board.

name: Pepper's Ghost
mechanic: While spotlit, an intangible duplicate of this card appears in the opposite zone; it scores in melds but cannot be touched, moved, or targeted.

name: Performance Rings
mechanic: Rows 1-5 pay 1x, rows 6-10 pay 2x, rows 11-15 pay 3x, and so on by board depth.

name: Pierrot
mechanic: Gains bonus multiplier on odd-numbered shows of the tour; has no effect otherwise.

name: Pink Lemonade
mechanic: When a Flames card and a Concessions card score in the same row, gain bonus points and draw 1 card.

name: Poker Crown
mechanic: When scored, this card and the 4 cards directly above it in its column are also evaluated as a poker hand, once.

name: Poker Evaluator
mechanic: Evaluates each scored line for its best poker hand; only the best poker hand per line pays.

name: Popcorn Cascade
mechanic: Whenever a column of 4 or more cards scores, draw 1 card.

name: Presentation
mechanic: While spotlit, each time a placed card's rank is higher than the last card placed, gain +1 combo for the act.

name: Press Bribery
mechanic: Once: on failing a city, keep touring as if it were won; if still unspent by the final city, converts to an automatic win there.

name: Psycho
mechanic: Every Next, automatically plays the top card of the draw deck into this card's column.

name: Railroad Jump
mechanic: Map-edge hazard: traveling this route costs one card, permanently removed from the deck.

name: Rare
mechanic: While in the deck, doubles the chance of Epic cards appearing in packs/shops.

name: Revealing
mechanic: This card's modifiers stay active while covered.

name: Ring Column
mechanic: One per column: adds one board (lower zone) column at game creation; its rank equals which column it is.

name: Ringmaster's Grip
mechanic: This card and the stack it heads can always be picked up, regardless of stack legality.

name: Roman Numerals
mechanic: This card's rank displays as Roman numerals; melds, stacking and comparisons are unaffected.

name: Rosin
mechanic: Cards placed onto this card cannot be picked up again, but score +1 bonus per ring deeper than they stand.

name: Sawdust
mechanic: When this card is discarded from the board, its slot keeps a marker that gives the next card placed there bonus points on its first score.

name: Sawing in Half
mechanic: Cue: split a target card into two same-suit cards of half rank (one rounded up, one down); this card exhausts for the show.

name: Searing Knife
mechanic: When scored, its column pays 3x this act but is locked (no placement or grabs) for the next 2 turns.

name: Second Act
mechanic: After every shuffle, this card is placed exactly at the deck's midpoint and enters play alone.

name: Self-Granted Title
mechanic: This card counts as one rarity higher for all effects and bonuses, but not for pack or shop pool rolls.

name: Sin of Gluttony
mechanic: Consumes cards from anywhere (board, Entrance, or decks, via cue), with no cap, permanently gaining rank.

name: Slapstick
mechanic: Cue: swap the ranks of this card and one adjacent card.

name: Sliced Bread
mechanic: On submission, if a same-suit card sits lower in this card's stack, gain a point per card between them.

name: Snake Oil
mechanic: Consumable: gives +3 rank to one card this show, with a seeded 1-in-4 chance of doing nothing.

name: Soundcheck
mechanic: At show start, grants one free move (grab and place one stack) before the first Next, without spending an act.

name: Spangle
mechanic: The first time this card is part of any scored meld each act, it adds +1 to the act's combo.

name: Spiderweb
mechanic: When scored, gains +1 point per card diagonally adjacent to it.

name: Spirit Photo
mechanic: Consumable: creates an intangible ghost copy of an owned card that plays for one show at half score, then disappears.

name: Stone
mechanic: Once placed on the board this card cannot be grabbed again, and it scores a bonus for remaining unmoved.

name: Straitjacket
mechanic: Starts each show unable to be moved; frees itself and scores bonus points the first time its column scores.

name: Sword Swallower
mechanic: Hidden rule: a column that is one perfect descending run from top to floor pays a large bonus and mints a Knife-suit card.

name: Symmetrical Show
mechanic: Poker hands are also evaluated on columns in addition to rows.

name: Tappable Clown
mechanic: 3 charges per show: cue to deterministically re-roll the ranks of all adjacent cards.

name: Temperance Town
mechanic: Town hazard: Concessions-class cards are disabled and shop prices are doubled.

name: The Accountant
mechanic: At payout, before row x column multiplication, shift up to 20% of the larger axis total onto the smaller, costing 2 combo to invoke.

name: The Acrobat
mechanic: This card can be grabbed even while covered; the cards above cascade down one slot.

name: The Advance Campaign
mechanic: Cue before a show: spend N Gold tokens to multiply that show's fame payout by 1 + N/10.

name: The Advance Man
mechanic: Consumable: reveals all fog-of-war nodes within 2 edges of the player's position, including contents.

name: The Aerialist
mechanic: Leader: re-scores the topmost meld once per submit, but is destroyed permanently if her column ever fails to score.

name: The Alchemist
mechanic: Cue: transmute all statuses of one class on a target card into another class, count preserved.

name: The Ambitious Card
mechanic: This card always rises to the top of the draw deck after any shuffle or discard, and scores bonus points if drawn the same show it was discarded.

name: The Amendment
mechanic: Attach any owned stamp to a rule card in the rules deck.

name: The Anarchist
mechanic: Boss: each submit, disables one of your beneficial rule cards for the rest of the show, in an order it chooses.

name: The Apprentice
mechanic: Blank skill; each show it permanently learns the first effect it observes firing, up to three learned effects.

name: The Avatar
mechanic: This card copies another deck card's name, class, and identity for all checks until it has scored 3 times, at which point it is unmasked.

name: The Backward-Backward
mechanic: Cue: reverse the run direction of one column for the rest of the show, so descending counts as ascending and vice versa.

name: The Balance
mechanic: Final-tier boss: cannot be beaten by score; win by ending the show with row total and column total within 10% of each other.

name: The Belt
mechanic: Exactly one card in the save file holds this stamp at a time; it scores double, and a Belt-challenge boss can take it and it must be won back.

name: The Best Bower
mechanic: This card counts as every suit for flush evaluation, but not for suit-stacking rules.
status: Added (added effect that it randomly acts as any prop from the game)

name: The Bishop
mechanic: May be placed onto any card along an open diagonal, capturing it; blocked by occupied slots between.

name: The Blank
mechanic: This card has no rank or suit: it can stack on anything and anything can stack on it, but it never melds and scores 0.

name: The Blockhead
mechanic: Absorbs one Knife prop per show, banking it as flat points instead of being hit.

name: The Booking
mechanic: Declares a goal/term for the show (e.g. score X with no Knife melds); fulfilling it grants bonus fame, missing it triggers a worse penalty.

name: The Boot Code
mechanic: Passes a buff down its row card-to-card without triggering, invisible to effects that count or punish triggers.

name: The Bullet Catch
mechanic: When scored in the Spotlight, scores 10x rank, but has a seeded 1-in-13 chance of being destroyed instead.

name: The Butoh Walker
mechanic: Moves one slot automatically every other turn; every slot it leaves permanently grants bonus points to the next card scored there.

name: The Butterfly Trick
mechanic: Cue: create two rank-1 paper-token cards of any suit that drift down one chosen column, one row per Next.

name: The Calliope
mechanic: Gains +1 combo for every different class that scored this act.

name: The Calm Voice
mechanic: Once per run, negate a disaster event or boss effect and gain fame equal to its severity instead.

name: The Candy Butcher
mechanic: Whenever a full 5-card row meld scores, mints one Ticket Stub to the deck.

name: The Cannon King
mechanic: Leader: Fireworks-suit cards may score directly from the Grand Entrance without entering the board.

name: The Capoeirista
mechanic: Registered as a Dancer but functions as an Escape Artist; town bans on Escape Artist-type acts still let it perform.

name: The Card Index
mechanic: Cue, once per show: search the draw deck for any card and put it into the Grand Entrance.

name: The Castell
mechanic: Formation: a stack of 6+ cards topped by the lowest-ranked card pays a large bonus at scoring; if the stack is broken by a hazard first, lose double the bonus instead.

name: The Charivari
mechanic: If 4 or more cards are placed into the board on the first turn of a show, gain bonus multiplier on the first act's payout.

name: The Cheap Pop
mechanic: When scored, grants a small bonus fame in every town.

name: The Claque
mechanic: Consumable: raises this show's fame floor to 60% of goal, but costs 1 Gold at every subsequent show forever.

name: The Cliffhanger
mechanic: Cue at show end: the next town's goal drops 30%, but this card must score in that show or lose double the discount as fame.

name: The Clock Hang
mechanic: May be placed half-off the board past the last column; while hanging it is double-spotlit (its skill fires twice), but any board-shift effect discards it.

name: The Comedic Drop
mechanic: Cue: discard this card mid-show for a bonus larger than scoring it would have paid.

name: The Conductor
mechanic: All on-Next effects are held each turn and fire together at Submit instead, in a chosen order.

name: The Conjuror
mechanic: Leader: once per turn, produce a rank-1 token card of any suit into the Entrance.

name: The Contagion
mechanic: Each Next, every status on this card's neighbors copies one card further outward, with merge-by-class capping the counts.

name: The Contortionist
mechanic: May share one board slot with another card; both cards count in melds.

name: The Contrary
mechanic: Descending runs count as ascending, and the worst poker hand scores instead of the best, on each row.

name: The Convention
mechanic: Enact one new law chosen from a fixed slate of three (e.g. runs wrap King-to-Ace, 4-card poker hands score, discards feed 10% of rank as points); it becomes a permanent rule card for the rest of the run.

name: The Cooler
mechanic: Consumable, once per run: replaces the remaining draw deck with a copy in a chosen order.

name: The Costume Fitting
mechanic: On show start, copies the stamp of one adjacent card for the duration of the show.

name: The Costumier
mechanic: Leader: all your cards may hold 2 stamps.

name: The Courier
mechanic: While spotlit, this card counts as a member of both its own column's and the adjacent column's melds.

name: The Critic
mechanic: After each act, the effect that triggered most is silenced for the next act; any effect that triggered exactly once scores a bonus.

name: The Crowd Surf
mechanic: Cue: pass this card across the tops of all columns to the far edge, scoring bonus points per column crossed; if any crossed column is empty, this card is discarded instead.

name: The Cue Card
mechanic: Cue: manually fire one adjacent card's trigger hook exactly as if the game had triggered it, including combo credit and stamps.

name: The Dalang
mechanic: Leader: while in play, the player chooses the trigger order of all card effects each scoring pass.

name: The Designated Loser
mechanic: A boss show with a trivial goal that is normally always won, but has a hidden seeded 1-in-1000 chance the goal silently triples mid-show.

name: The Digesting Duck
mechanic: Consumes cards dropped on it like Gluttony, but secretly stores them; cue to return any one stored card to the Entrance.

name: The Discoverie
mechanic: Consumable, 3 uses: reveals every Gaff/fake in play (yours, the shop's, the town's); banned (a crime event) in pious towns.

name: The Double
mechanic: Assign a 'star' card at show start; the first destruction or debuff aimed at the star hits this card instead.

name: The Dragoman
mechanic: Choose a card: its on-score effects also fire when it is discarded.

name: The Dragon Meld
mechanic: When a run of 4+ scores while this card is in it, that run can be relocated as a unit anywhere on the board once, next turn.

name: The Dramaturg
mechanic: Rewrites one card's combo identity so each of its triggers registers a fresh combo key every time this act, instead of only on first activation.

name: The Drone Swarm
mechanic: Cue, once per show: re-triggers any formation bonus already scored this run, paying it again without needing the cards.

name: The Dubplate
mechanic: Event-forged unique card created for this save file, assembled from the two effects scored most this run.

name: The Dzhigit's Pickup
mechanic: During Next, once armed by cue, intercepts one falling card as it drops and redirects it to any column.

name: The Egg Bag
mechanic: Cue while spotlit: stash the top discard inside this card; when this card scores, the stashed card returns to the Grand Entrance.

name: The Egress
mechanic: Cue: send any board card to the discard, gaining 1 Ticket Stub.

name: The Encore
mechanic: If this card's skill triggered this show, there is a seeded 50% chance it triggers once more at show end.

name: The Engineer
mechanic: Leader: gamble-tagged cards cost 1 less to acquire and their destruction odds are halved.

name: The Equestrian
mechanic: Leader: melds scored entirely within rows 1-5 get bonus multiplier.

name: The Escape Map
mechanic: When discarded, reveals part of the world map's fog of war.

name: The Escapologist
mechanic: Leader: free undo becomes 2 per turn, and all debuffs on your cards expire one show sooner.

name: The Exchange Rate
mechanic: At act end, cue to convert unused combo above 3 into flat points at a fixed rate, or spend points to pre-register +1 combo for the next act.

name: The Fadista
mechanic: Scores bonus points per card destroyed or lost this run.

name: The Falling Wall
mechanic: Boss attack, telegraphed one turn ahead: destroys an entire column except one exact row slot.

name: The Fanchant
mechanic: After all scoring resolves, each meld that raised the act's combo pays again at 25%.

name: The Fifteen
mechanic: This card also melds with any adjacent neighbors whose ranks sum to 15 with it.

name: The Fire Breather
mechanic: Cue: apply Burning to every card in this card's entire row; this card becomes Exhausted.

name: The Fire-Knife
mechanic: This card is fixed dual-suit Knives and Flames: knife props fly the row while Burning status drops down the column.

name: The Fire Marshal
mechanic: Town hazard: Flames-suit cards cannot score, and any Flames card in the deck is treated as Wax type this show.

name: The Forged Ace
mechanic: This card has an enormous rank that counts as two Aces in melds; if any inspection effect examines it, it is destroyed and the show's fame payout is voided.

name: The Forty-Two
mechanic: Hidden rule: when a row's score plus its column's score totals exactly 42, the act's combo gains +3.

name: The Fourth Wall
mechanic: Once per act, during scoring resolution, pauses the show to allow one grab/place before resolution continues.

name: The Gentled Beast
mechanic: Cards dropped on this card are not consumed but returned to the column below it; each one permanently adds +1 to this card's score bonus.

name: The Ghost Writer
mechanic: Each show start, writes a temporary skill (a copy of an effect that fired last show) onto one blank/prop card; it fades at show end.

name: The Gong
mechanic: Town hazard: any submit scoring under 25% of goal ends the show immediately.

name: The Grease Joint
mechanic: At show start, discards the bottom card of the draw deck, then draws 1 card.

name: The Griot
mechanic: Preserves up to 20% of a show's unspent score into the next show's opening total, and re-triggers one chosen effect from last show at the next show's start.

name: The Groundhog
mechanic: Cue, once per show: replay the previous act's entire effect sequence against the current board, same effects and order, targets resolved fresh.

name: The Guest Star
mechanic: Consumable: a random Legendary card joins the deck for exactly 3 shows then departs, kept permanently if a hidden condition is met during its stay.

name: The Half Card
mechanic: This card has half rank (rounded down) and half size: two copies occupy one board slot together and meld as one combined card.
status: Modified (either talent that splits into two halves down middle, or becomes two cards where rank is half. recombines on score as its own meld)

name: The Handicap
mechanic: Cue at show start: lock this card's movement for the show (cannot be grabbed) in exchange for scoring double all show.

name: The Hanged Man
mechanic: Consumable: flips the order of one entire stack, bottom becomes top.

name: The Hat Line
mechanic: At show end, cue to convert the act's unused combo above the payout into Gold tokens instead of losing it.

name: The Headliner
mechanic: Aces are renamed and count as either rank 1 or rank 14 in runs, whichever is more favorable, decided at evaluation time.

name: The High Dive
mechanic: Cue: drop this card from the top of its column to the bottom, scoring bonus points per row fallen.

name: The Holdout
mechanic: Stores one card outside the game across shows; cue once per run to insert it into any stack at any moment, but a town search loses it.

name: The Hook
mechanic: Town hazard: after each submit, the lowest-ranked board card is discarded unless it scored that act.

name: The Hunger Artist
mechanic: Gains bonus points for every consecutive show it stays in the deck unplayed; when finally played and scored, pays it all at once and resets to zero.

name: The Illustrated
mechanic: This card may hold unlimited stamps, but can never hold a skill.

name: The Imitator
mechanic: Choose a deck card at acquisition: this card scores 150% of that card's base points, but only while the original is not on the board.

name: The Impresario
mechanic: Kings are renamed, count as Producer-class cards, and give +1 trade value when spent at shops.
